content: Lenacapavir, a moderate CYP3A4 inhibitor, can increase the plasma levels of CYP3A4 substrates initiated within nine months after the last subcutaneous dose of lenacapavir. This elevation in substrate levels may heighten the risk of adverse reactions associated with these drugs. Close monitoring is recommended. When co-administering lenacapavir with acalabrutinib, reduce the acalabrutinib dose from 100 mg orally every 12 hours to 100 mg orally once daily. Monitor closely for any adverse effects. Lenacapavir increases the levels or effects of adagrasib by altering hepatic and intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor the patient closely. Lenacapavir can elevate the levels or effects of ado-trastuzumab emtansine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor the patient. Lenacapavir increases the levels or effects of alfentanil by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Lenacapavir can increase the levels or effects of alfuzosin by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor the patient. Lenacapavir elevates the levels or effects of alpelisib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Lenacapavir increases the levels or effects of alprazolam by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor the patient. Lenacapavir can elevate the levels or effects of amiodarone by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Lenacapavir increases the levels or effects of amlodipine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor the patient. Amobarbital decreases the levels or effects of lenacapavir by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Avoid co-administration of lenacapavir with moderate CYP3A4 inducers, as they may reduce lenacapavir's efficacy. Apalutamide decreases the levels or effects of lenacapavir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. Lenacapavir increases the levels or effects of apixaban by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Lenacapavir elevates the levels or effects of apremilast by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor the patient. Lenacapavir increases the levels or effects of aprepitant by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Drugs that inhibit P-gp, UGT1A1, and strongly inhibit CYP3A may significantly increase lenacapavir plasma concentrations. Monitor closely. Lenacapavir elevates the levels or effects of atorvastatin by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor the patient. Lenacapavir increases the levels or effects of avanafil by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Lenacapavir elevates the levels or effects of avapritinib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor the patient. Lenacapavir increases the levels or effects of avatrombopag by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Lenacapavir elevates the levels or effects of axitinib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor the patient. Belzutifan decreases the levels or effects of lenacapavir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Bexarotene reduces the levels or effects of lenacapavir by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Lenacapavir increases the levels or effects of bortezomib by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Bosentan decreases the levels or effects of lenacapavir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Lenacapavir elevates the levels or effects of bosutinib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor the patient. Lenacapavir increases the levels or effects of brentuximab vedotin by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Lenacapavir elevates the levels or effects of brexpiprazole by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor the patient. Lenacapavir increases the levels or effects of bromocriptine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Lenacapavir elevates the levels or effects of buprenorphine by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. When initiating buprenorphine while on lenacapavir, use the lowest feasible initial or maintenance dose of buprenorphine and carefully titrate to the desired effect. When initiating lenacapavir while taking buprenorphine, consider adjusting the buprenorphine dose. Monitor clinical signs and symptoms. Lenacapavir increases the levels or effects of buprenorphine buccal, subdermal implant, transdermal, and long-acting injection formulations by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Adjust buprenorphine dosing as needed and monitor clinical signs and symptoms. Lenacapavir elevates the levels or effects of buspirone by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor the patient. Lenacapavir increases the levels or effects of busulfan by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Butabarbital decreases the levels or effects of lenacapavir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Butalbital reduces the levels or effects of lenacapavir by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Lenacapavir increases the levels or effects of cabozantinib by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor the patient.
